name: intercom-nav
description: Group ride intercom: live rider map, shared route, voice, music ducking, SOS and break alerts

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @intercom/server" "npm run dev -w @intercom/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @intercom/web && npm run build -w @intercom/server
